::: {.obsidian-apology-letter}
:::

State the apology directly in the first sentence. Name what went
wrong and the effect on the reader.

# What happened

Give the facts of the failure. Do not make excuses or shift blame.

# What we are doing

State the corrective actions and the owner of each. Give a date for
the correction.

# What we have changed

State the change that stops the failure recurring.

# Offer

State any goodwill offered, such as a discount or a credit.
